signIn.title: Sign in to keep your designs
signIn.body: Creations and gem groups belong to your Global Toothgems account. During the preview they are kept in this browser, on this device. The design on the stage stays here while you sign in.

saving.question: How does saving work?
saving.answer: The Studio keeps a draft of your current design on this device automatically. “Save creation” adds it to My Creations, under your account, where you can reopen, duplicate or reuse it — during the preview, your library is kept in this browser, so it shows on this device only. Once saved, “Save changes” updates it, and the status next to the name always tells you whether everything is stored.

groups.question: What’s a Gem Group?
groups.answer: A reusable arrangement of several gems — like a macro. Select two or more gems and choose “Create Gem Group”: their spacing, rotation, size and finish are kept. Later, drag the group onto any tooth, and each gem stays individually editable.

estimate.question: How is the estimated price calculated?
estimate.answer: Each gem has an indicative price by type, adjusted for its size, and the estimate adds them up. It is a conversation aid for you and your client — not a catalogue price, and nothing is charged from it.

help.title: Learn the Studio in a few minutes
help.sub: Six short lessons, from your first gem to reusable design blocks. Open the steps only when you need them.
help.feedbackBody: Tell us what felt confusing — the Studio is still in preview and your feedback shapes it.

shortcuts.multi: Add a gem to the selection

choose.title: Choose a gem
choose.summary: Browse crystals, shapes and precious pieces in the library on the left.
steps: Open the Gems tab of the library.
Search by name, or scroll through the three families.
Click a gem to pick it up — it is now ready to place.

place.title: Place it on the jaw
place.summary: Drag the gem onto a tooth, then fine-tune its position, size and angle.
steps: Drag a gem onto a tooth, or click a tooth once a gem is picked up.
Drag a placed gem to slide it across the enamel — it never overlaps another.
Adjust size, rotation, finish and colour in the panel on the right.

compose.title: Create a composition
compose.summary: Combine several gems, mirror them, and align them along the smile.
steps: Add more gems — Shift + click selects several at once; drag one of them to move the whole selection.
Use Mirror to copy a gem to the other side of the smile.
Distribute or Align to line up a selection along the arch.

save.title: Save your creation
save.summary: Name your design and keep it in My Creations to reopen it any time.
steps: Press “Save creation” (or Ctrl + S) at the top right.
Give it a name, and optionally a description and tags.
Reopen it from My Creations: it comes back exactly as you left it.

groups.title: Create reusable groups
groups.summary: Turn a few gems you often place together into a one-click Gem Group.
steps: Select two or more gems on the stage.
Choose “Create Gem Group” in the panel on the right, then name it.
Find it in My Gem Groups and in the library’s My Groups tab.

reuse.title: Reuse your designs
reuse.summary: Drop saved groups onto new smiles, or duplicate a creation into a variation.
steps: In the library’s My Groups tab, drag a group onto any tooth.
Each gem of the group stays editable once it is placed.
Duplicate a saved creation to explore a variation without touching the original.

welcome.title: Welcome to the Tooth Gem Studio
welcome.body: Create, experiment and save your own designs on a 3D smile. Here is the whole idea in three quick steps.

place.title: Drag a gem onto a tooth
place.body: Pick a gem in the library on the left and drop it on any tooth. Drag it again to slide it across the enamel.

compose.title: Compose and adjust
compose.body: Select a gem to change its size, rotation and finish on the right. Shift + click selects several — mirror, align, or save them as a reusable Gem Group.

save.title: Save and reuse
save.body: “Save creation” keeps your design in My Creations. Your gem groups wait in My Gem Groups, ready to drop onto the next smile.
